title: 第12章  这特么谁顶得住？
slug: 我一杂役怎么成掌门孩子他爹了
content_zh:
“我连杂役峰长老都杀了，更何况你们两个杂役峰执事？”
叶长天冷冷一笑。
虽然以他如今的实力，宋浩二人已经对他造成不了任何威胁。
可他就算放这二人一马，这二人也绝不会感激他。
一旦逮到机会，他们说不定就像那隐藏在暗中的毒蛇一般，冷不丁地在暗中咬他一口。
还是斩草除根，永绝后患为妙！
虽说太玄宗表面上有着禁止同门互相残杀的规定，但在这个肉弱强食的世界，暗地里为了争夺修炼资源互相残杀的可不在少数。
对于宗门来说，价值才是第一位。
他一个二十岁的筑基境，远远比一个炼气九层的杂役峰长老、两个炼气三层的杂役峰执事更有价值。
宗门难道还能为了几个没有价值的死人来处理掉他不成？
见得叶长天根本没有放过他们的意思，宋浩与张奎哪里还敢有丝毫的犹豫，连滚带爬地转身逃窜而去。
叶长天抬手一挥。
咻！咻！
两道劲气就穿透了宋浩与张奎的身体。
两人甚至连惨叫都没来得及发出一声，就没了任何生命的气息。
轻描淡写地解决宋浩二人，就在叶长天准备处理掉地上几具尸体的时候，两道人影朝着叶长天所在的地方匆匆而来。
其中一人，正是消失了半天的月青霜。
另一位长相方正的中年男子，叶长天也不陌生，正是杂役峰峰主方云，也是杂役峰唯一拥有筑基境修为的存在。
当他们看到地上三人一鸟的尸体，都是久久没能回过神来。
月青霜从内门回来后，第一时间就得知了叶长天的情况。

因为担心叶长天的安全。
她就暴露了一些关系，找到了杂役峰峰主方云。
等他们来到这里的时候，却没想到看到的竟然是眼前这震撼的一幕。
身为杂役峰峰主的方云人都麻了。
无论是炼气七层的火云鸟，还是炼气九层的杂役峰长老宋元德，都被叶长天干掉了！
叶长天不是一名杂役弟子么？
这特么是一名杂役弟子能干出来的事情？
简直就离谱！
而月青霜美眸中的震惊之色，比起方云更是有过之而无不及。
她比方云更清楚叶长天的情况。
半天前。
她来杂役峰找到叶长天的时候，叶长天还不过炼气四层的修为。
结果不到一会儿。
叶长天只是随便修炼了一下，修为先是蹭蹭蹭地涨到了炼气七层，然后又蹭蹭地涨到了炼气九层。
如今她与叶长天分开仅仅半天。
叶长天竟然又突破筑基境了。
就这变态的突破速度，你特么告诉我这是伪灵根的废材？
这要是废材，她这个天灵根岂不是连废材都不如？
“难道长天师兄拥有的是传说中的仙品灵根，只是一直没有被发掘出来，所以才被误认成伪灵根的废物？”
月青霜目光微微闪烁。

一定是了！
也只有传说中的仙灵根，才知道师尊让她来找叶长天了。
如果说在这之前，月青霜来找叶长天是出于对师尊夏秋水的信任，现在她是百分百相信叶长天能够帮助自己重回巅峰了！
一定要尽快与长天师兄完成双修！
“叶长天，你……你将他们都杀了？”
方云抬头看着叶长天，久久难以从震撼中回过神来。
“方峰主，你来了。”
叶长天一脸无辜地道：“我说是宋元德父子先要置我于死地，我只是正当防卫，你信不信？”
“我信。”
方云擦了一把冷汗。
虽然方云也不知道，这家伙明明都筑基境了，为何还一直窝杂役峰做一名不起眼的杂役弟子。
可二十来岁的筑基境，这都足以媲美内门的天才弟子了。
宗门高层若是知道叶长天的存在，绝对会将叶长天送到内门去重点培养的。
方云又岂会傻傻地与叶长天为敌？
更何况——
叶长天还与他身旁这一位关系很不一般呢。
方云就更不会冒然罪叶长天了。
“方峰主，既然你来了，这你就交给你来处理吧，我与青霜师妹先闪了。”
叶长天笑着打了个招呼，然后就与月青霜离开了。
“……”

望着叶长天二人离去的背影，方云只能苦笑着摇了摇头，开始善后工作。
等解决完这里的事情，还是赶紧上报宗门高层，将这个煞星从杂役峰送走吧。
回到住处。
折腾了一天的叶长天实在有些累了，简单地洗漱一翻就倒在床榻上呼呼大睡起来。
而月青霜则是在琢磨着与叶长天双修的事情。
她洗完澡，换了一身性感的睡裙，脑海中将从师姐那学来的经验过了一遍，这才鼓起勇气回到了叶长天的房间。
可当她回到房间的时候，才发现叶长天已经睡着了。
“……”
月青霜顿时一阵泄气。
她不就是就想找叶长天双修一个么？
怎么就这么难呢。
不管了，先爬上长天师兄的床再说。
根据师姐传授的经验，男人一觉睡醒后有时候那方面的欲望就会很强烈。
只要跟长天师兄睡在一起，凭借自己的美貌与身材，长天师兄一觉醒来未必经受得起这般诱惑，到时候双修还不是水到渠成的事情？
叶长天这一觉睡得很香。
梦里，叶长天还梦到了一位绝色美女要与他双修。
可正当叶长天进行到关键时刻，却是感觉自己关键部分被什么东西压住了，瞬间就惊醒了过来。
他低头一看。
只见穿着一层透明轻纱的月青霜，竟然不止何时睡在了他怀里。
而压住他关键部分的，正是月青霜修长而雪白的玉腿。

叶长天这一低头，几乎将全身上下所有美好的风景一览无余，顿时鼻血都差点流了出来。
“……”
叶长天人都麻了。
这要身材有身材，要相貌有相貌的便宜师妹，竟然半夜里爬上了他的床？
这特么谁顶得住啊。
虽说叶长天也知道，月青霜之所以来找他，就是为了跟他双修恢复根基与实力的。
可他是个很有原则的人。
月青霜现在可是他的金主爸爸，金主爸爸没开口，他也不能直接就上吧？
摇了摇头。
叶长天甩开脑海中乱七八糟的想法，赶紧起身洗了个冷水脸，然后在一旁打坐修炼起来。
content_en:
"I've even killed the elder of the Miscellaneous Peak, let alone the two deacons of the Miscellaneous Peak?"
Ye Changtian smiled coldly.
Although with his current strength, Song Hao and Song Hao no longer pose any threat to him.
But even if he lets these two people go, these two people will never be grateful to him.
Once they get the chance, they might be like the poisonous snakes hiding in the dark and bite him in the dark.
It’s better to eliminate the root cause and avoid future troubles forever!
Although Taixuan Sect ostensibly has regulations prohibiting fellow disciples from killing each other, in this world of the weak and the strong, there are many who secretly kill each other in order to compete for training resources.
For the sect, value is the first priority.
He, a twenty-year-old at the Foundation Establishment level, is far more valuable than a handyman peak elder at the ninth level of Qi refining and two handyman peak deacons at the third level of Qi refining.
Can the sect still deal with him for a few worthless dead people?
Seeing that Ye Changtian had no intention of letting them go, Song Hao and Zhang Kui didn't dare to hesitate at all, and turned around and fled away.
Ye Changtian raised his hand and waved.
call out! call out!
Two waves of energy penetrated the bodies of Song Hao and Zhang Kui.
The two of them didn't even have time to scream, before they lost any breath of life.
Song Hao and the two were dealt with lightly. Just when Ye Changtian was about to dispose of several corpses on the ground, two figures hurried towards where Ye Changtian was.
One of them was Yue Qingshuang, who had disappeared for a long time.
Another middle-aged man with a square appearance, Ye Changtian is no stranger to him. He is Fang Yun, the master of the Miscellaneous Peak, and the only person in the Miscellaneous Peak with the cultivation level of Foundation Establishment.
When they saw the bodies of three people and one bird on the ground, they couldn't recover for a long time.
After Yue Qingshuang came back from the inner gate, she immediately learned about Ye Changtian's situation.
Because he was worried about Ye Changtian's safety.
She exposed some connections and found Fang Yun, the leader of the handyman peak.
When they arrived here, they didn't expect to see this shocking scene in front of them.
Fang Yun, the leader of the handyman peak, was numb.
Whether it was Huoyunniao at the seventh level of Qi refining or Song Yuande, the elder of the handyman peak at the ninth level of Qi refining, they were all killed by Ye Changtian!
Isn't Ye Changtian a handyman disciple?
Is this something that a handyman disciple can do?
Simply outrageous!
The look of shock in Yue Qingshuang's beautiful eyes was even worse than that of Fang Yun.
She knew Ye Changtian's situation better than Fang Yun.
Half a day ago.
When she came to Yiyong Peak to find Ye Changtian, Ye Changtian was only at the fourth level of Qi Refining.
The result was less than a moment later.
Ye Changtian just practiced casually, and his cultivation slowly rose to the seventh level of Qi Refining first, and then to the ninth level of Qi Refining.
Now she and Ye Changtian have only been separated for half a day.
Ye Changtian unexpectedly broke through to the foundation building realm again.
With such an abnormal breakthrough speed, why are you telling me that this is a waste material with pseudo-spiritual roots?
If this is a waste material, wouldn't her Tianlinggen be worse than a waste material?
"Could it be that what Senior Brother Changtian possesses is the legendary immortal spiritual root, but it has never been discovered, so he was mistaken for a waste with fake spiritual roots?"
Yue Qingshuang's eyes flickered slightly.
It must be!
Only the legendary fairy root knew that the master asked her to come to Ye Changtian.
If before, Yue Qingshuang came to Ye Changtian out of trust in her master Xia Qiushui, now she is 100% convinced that Ye Changtian can help her return to the top!
We must complete dual cultivation with Senior Brother Changtian as soon as possible!
"Ye Changtian, you...you killed them all?"
Fang Yun looked up at Ye Changtian, unable to recover from the shock for a long time.
"Master Fang, you are here."
Ye Changtian said innocently: "I said that Song Yuande and his son wanted to kill me first. I was just acting in self-defense. Do you believe it?"
"I believe it."
Fang Yun wiped itCold sweat.
Although Fang Yun didn't know why this guy was still an inconspicuous handyman disciple in the handyman peak when he was already at the foundation level.
But those in their twenties at the Foundation Establishment level are comparable to the genius disciples of the inner sect.
If the senior leaders of the sect knew about Ye Changtian's existence, they would definitely send Ye Changtian to the inner sect for intensive training.
How could Fang Yun foolishly become an enemy of Ye Changtian?
What's more -
Ye Changtian also had a very unusual relationship with the person next to him.
Fang Yun would not offend Ye Changtian rashly.
"Master Fang, since you are here, I will leave it to you to handle this. Junior Sister Qingshuang and I will get out of the way first."
Ye Changtian smiled and said hello, and then left with Yue Qingshuang.
"..."
Looking at the departing figures of Ye Changtian and the others, Fang Yun could only shake his head with a wry smile and began to deal with the aftermath.
After the matter here is resolved, it is better to report it to the higher-ups of the sect and send this evil star away from the Miscellaneous Peak.
Return to your residence.
Ye Changtian was really tired after a hard day's work. He simply washed up and then fell on the bed and fell asleep.
Yue Qingshuang, on the other hand, was thinking about dual cultivation with Ye Changtian.
After she took a shower, she changed into a sexy nightgown. After going through the experiences she learned from her senior sister in her mind, she mustered up the courage to return to Ye Changtian's room.
But when she returned to the room, she found that Ye Changtian had fallen asleep.
"..."
Yue Qingshuang was suddenly discouraged.
Didn't she just want to find Ye Changtian to be a dual practitioner?
Why is it so difficult?
No matter, let’s climb into Senior Brother Changtian’s bed first.
According to the experience taught by my senior sister, men sometimes have very strong desires in that area after they wake up from sleep.
As long as he sleeps with Senior Brother Changtian, with his beauty and figure, Senior Brother Changtian may not be able to withstand such temptation when he wakes up. Isn't dual cultivation a matter of course?
Ye Changtian slept soundly.
In his dream, Ye Changtian also dreamed of a stunning beauty who wanted to practice double cultivation with him.
But just when Ye Changtian reached a critical moment, he felt that something was pressing on his key parts, and he woke up instantly.
He looked down.
Yue Qingshuang, who was wearing a layer of transparent gauze, was seen sleeping in his arms more than once.
What was holding his key part down was Yue Qingshuang's slender and snow-white legs.
When Ye Changtian lowered his head, he could see almost all the beautiful scenery all over his body, and his nose almost started to bleed.
"..."
Ye Changtian was numb.
This cheap junior sister with a good figure and good looks actually climbed into his bed in the middle of the night?
Who the hell can withstand this?
Although Ye Changtian also knew that the reason why Yue Qingshuang came to him was to restore her foundation and strength through dual cultivation with him.
But he is a very principled person.
Yue Qingshuang is now his sponsor father. Since the sponsor father didn't say anything, he can't go directly, right?
Shaked his head.
Ye Changtian shook off the messy thoughts in his mind, quickly stood up, washed his face with cold water, and then meditated beside him.
